description: Типовой научный расчётный профиль по выбору пользователя. Не идентификация фактической комплектации.

coupler_integrity.notes: 2/2.5MN are GOST33434 design minima, NOT fracture. 4MN is an explicit nominal engineering scenario, not a measured universal SA-3 breaking force. Actual fracture depends on steel, defects, age, temperature and geometry. Compression overload warns; broken pieces retain unilateral compression contact without recoupling.

reference_scope.inertia: Fixed equivalent rotating masses 50000kg loco + 75*2800kg wagons; effective6460000kg, physical6200000kg. Literature estimates, not invented component inertias.
reference_scope.wagon_brakes: GOST34434-2018 appendixG effectiveness reference at maximum65mm stroke with rod slack adjuster. Two254mm cylinders form a typical mechanical surrogate driven by the current wagon BC pressure. This replaces the legacy994cm2/5.79 force calibration; pneumatic pressure generation and effective air volume are not claimed newly identified.
reference_scope.locomotive_brakes: Four bogies with independently measured pressure, four670V203mm cylinders/eight shoes each. 1200N spring reference from Sinitsyn/Kobishchanov2020; eight-point-eight total lever per cylinder, split across two shoes. Not an OEM certificate of this2ES6. Friction curve: generic locomotive type-M/high-phosphorus PTR law, not a proven OEM material grade or UIC certification.
reference_scope.air_load_mode: Native wagon AR1/load mode remains pneumatic input behavior. The mechanical rod slack-adjuster force is a separate quantity and is not inferred from that bit.
reference_scope.couplers: Published scientific equivalent pair; equipment identity is a reference scenario selected by the user.
reference_scope.regime: Dry ordinary tread braking; no accepted wheel-slide, thermal-fade or ice/wet calibration.
